localIntro: City ballot questions below are copied from the official list linked for this place. That list does not print candidate names for these questions.

4260000.office: Question #1. Proposed Charter Change. Should the Philadelphia Home Rule Charter be amended to revise the City’s contracting procedures to allow for bid preferences and set-asides for small businesses; modify the threshold and standards for contracts that can be set aside for small and local businesses; and grant the Procurement Department and the City Solicitor discretion on bond requirements for certain construction projects?

Question #2. Proposed Charter Change. Shall the Philadelphia Home Rule Charter be amended to establish and define the functions of Creative Philadelphia, an office headed by the Chief Cultural Officer to promote the City’s arts, culture, and creative economy sector?

4207992.office: Proposed amendment to the Borough of Braddock Home Rule Charter. Shall Article 2, Section 204 of the Home Rule Charter of the Borough of Braddock be amended to provide that Borough Council members shall receive compensation on a per-meeting basis based on their attendance at twelve (12) regularly scheduled annual Borough Council meetings subject to excused absences?

4220432.office: City of Duquesne proposed Home Rule Charter special election question. Shall the Home Rule Charter contained in the report, dated July 20, 2026, of the Government Study Commission, prepared in accordance with the Home Rule Charter and Optional Plans Law, be adopted by the City of Duquesne?

4259040.office: Proposed amendment to the Municipality of Penn Hills Home Rule Charter. Shall the Penn Hills Home Rule Charter be amended to clarify the process for appointing an Acting or Interim Municipal Manager by distinguishing between a temporary absence of the Manager and a vacancy in the office of Manager, and to authorize Council to designate an Acting or Interim Manager in the event of a vacancy?

4246792.office: Malvern Borough: Home Rule Charter Referendum. Shall the Home Rule Charter of the Borough of Malvern be amended to reduce the number of Members of Council from seven (7) to five (5) members, effective January 3, 2028, so that two (2) Members of Council are elected in 2027 and every four (4) years thereafter, and three (3) Members of Council are elected in 2029 and every four (4) years thereafter?

4260000.note: Question 1 was submitted by Bill No. 260457, which became law June 23, 2026, and Resolution No. 260467, adopted June 4, 2026. Question 2 was submitted by Bill No. 260264-A, which became law June 23, 2026, and Resolution No. 260270, adopted June 11, 2026. The candidates-for-office page names Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Representative in Congress, Senator in the General Assembly, and Representative in the General Assembly. It does not name a mayor or city council contest.

Allegheny County.office: Proposed amendment to the County of Allegheny Home Rule Charter. Shall Article III, Subsection 7(c) of Allegheny County's Home Rule Charter be repealed in order to remove restrictions on County Council members' ability to receive County funding for personal staff, district offices, and fringe benefits?

Delaware County.office: REFERENDUM: DELAWARE COUNTY WATER QUALITY, NATURAL AREAS, AND WILDLIFE HABITAT PROTECTION. Shall debt in the maximum principal amount of up to $120 million be authorized for purposes of financing land conservation, including protecting drinking water sources, water quality in rivers and creeks, wildlife habitat, conserving trees to protect air quality, conserving wetlands to prevent flooding, providing greenways and parks, protecting natural areas from development, and related costs, to be incurred by the County as debt approved by the voters, requiring public disclosure and annual independent audits?
